lines.t:
How much has been achieved in {{club_activities}} at
MEDA {{academy}}.
It rises as you complete each {{club}}'s assigned
{{achievement}} goals (max 150). The <c:ffff00>{{medal_level}}<c> of
<c:ffff00>{{medabot|pl}}<c> in the {{club}} can't grow beyond the activity
level.
As the {{activity_level}} rises, the shop in the school
building sells more items.
